scripts.build: CLOUDABLE_BUILD_VERSION=$(bun -e "const tag=(process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME||'').replace(/^v/,''); console.log(tag||require('./package.json').version)") CLOUDABLE_BUILD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) CLOUDABLE_BUILD_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --env 'CLOUDABLE_BUILD_*' --outfile=dist/cloudable-cli-linux-x64
scripts.build:arm64: CLOUDABLE_BUILD_VERSION=$(bun -e "const tag=(process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME||'').replace(/^v/,''); console.log(tag||require('./package.json').version)") CLOUDABLE_BUILD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) CLOUDABLE_BUILD_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --env 'CLOUDABLE_BUILD_*' --outfile=dist/cloudable-cli-linux-arm64
